subject: Fix false sharing in IO thread active-time and job-finished counters (#4976)
reason: The change only adds cache-line padding (_Alignas wrappers) around the io_jobs_finished counter and the per-IO-thread used_active_time_io_thread slots to eliminate false sharing. Every read and write keeps the same atomic operation, value, and memory order; the only change is the counters' memory layout, which compile-time static_asserts and the new unit tests in src/unit/test_io_threads.cpp already verify. No command reply, INFO semantics, persistence, replication, or failover behaviour changes — the single external consumer, INFO's used_active_time_io_thread_N, reports the same timing-depend
